clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Mangy Claw bears the mark of a deadly hunt. The great ice claw bear Mangeclaw killed a stranded dwarven pilot, and the severed claw proves the beast was slain.

Pilot Hildelve’s steam tank broke down in Dun Morogh’s frozen hills, leaving him to search for ore on foot and face the mountain wilderness alone. His recovered journal tells how he fought off an ice claw bear named Mangeclaw, though the struggle left him savagely mauled. The bear returned later and killed the weakened pilot. In his final written entry, Hildelve pleaded for vengeance. Taking the Mangy Claw from the fallen bear fulfills that request.
